title: Fire department budget request with 10 new positions
summary: A fire department chief walked the commission through the budget process in October 2024 ahead of the department's proposal. In November a chief proposed 10 new positions costing about $555,000 in the first year, and the commission voted to send the mayor a letter supporting the budget.

timeline.text: Motion to send a letter of support to the mayor for the fire chief's budget: The commission voted to send a letter of support to the mayor for the fire department's budget.
The department plans to rent a three- or four-bedroom house for off-duty firefighters working away from home.
A fire chief proposed 10 new positions costing about $555,000 in the first year.
A fire department chief explained how the budget works, ahead of the proposed budget at the next meeting.
